section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a multiple indirect effect model analysis examining how body image variables mediate the relationship between family fat talk and mindful eating. The model included BAS-2 (general body appreciation) and FBApS (functional body appreciation) as mediators, along with BMI and FFTQ-F as predictors. A significant indirect effect of family fat talk on mindful eating through functional body appreciation was found (β = −0.06, p = .01), but the corresponding indirect effect through general body appreciation was not significant (β = 0.02, p = .16).

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a multiple indirect effect model analysis examining how body image variables mediate the relationship between family fat talk and mindful eating. The model accounted for 20% of variance in mindful eating scores, with functional body appreciation (FBApS) emerging as a significant mediator (β = 0.35, p < .001), while general body appreciation (BAS-2) did not show a significant indirect effect. Table 1 provides descriptive statistics and zero-order correlations for all variables, including a correlation of -0.30 between Body Appreciation and BMI.
